name: svg-editor-generator
description: Editor visual de SVG para Windows
author: SVG Editor Generator

scripts.format: prettier --write src public scripts tests docs *.md *.json .github/workflows/*.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src public scripts tests docs *.md *.json .github/workflows/*.yml
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build:tests && node --test tests/geometry.cjs tests/editor.cjs tests/storage.cjs tests/interaction.cjs
